notes: «- واللفظ لعلي وزهير -» is a gloss on whose wording is used and is left out
«قال علي أخبرنا» names no teacher for Ali; «وقال الآخران، حدثنا سفيان» gives Sufyan for all three, so Sufyan is one shared level
«قال سمع عمرو، جابرا» : Sufyan heard Amr (Ibn Dinar, not written as such) who heard Jabir, so Amr is the second occurrence of that word
